entries.subject: The story is loud enough for a podium
entries.body:
[i]“Half the press corps is writing the {client} story this week whether you talk or not. Give them a room, a statement and twenty minutes — or let them write it from the sidewalk.”[/i]

A press conference is a bet: played well it takes the air out of the story, played badly it hands out matches at a gas leak.

choices.label: No podium — starve the story

effects.text: No press conference. The story keeps simmering on other people's stoves.

choices.outcome: The room stays dark. The typewriters do not.

expire_effects.text: The window for a press conference closes by itself — the columnists take that personally.
